scripts.deploy: npm run build && git worktree add -f /tmp/gh-pages gh-pages 2>/dev/null || git worktree add -f --detach /tmp/gh-pages; rsync -a --delete --exclude .git dist/ /tmp/gh-pages/ && cd /tmp/gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -qm "deploy" ; git push -f origin HEAD:gh-pages; cd - >/dev/null; git worktree remove -f /tmp/gh-pages
